stages.mythic: Edit the concept and go much further. Keep the huge dark oak and stone barn with its great steep roof, loft doors overflowing with wheat, loaded carts and sacks. The towering element: from the middle of the ridge rises a soaring tower of oak lofts, five storeys high, far above the roof, each storey overhanging the one below and each with an open door spilling wheat, like a tall stack of barns, topped by a long hoist beam with a heavy sack on its rope.
